text:
carla: Heads up — starting canary for release v2.8.0 in us-west at 14:00 UTC. Change window is 14:00-15:00. Deploy-bot will kick off a 5% canary, then 25% if green. DB migration is feature-flag gated (non-blocking). I want owners, rollback criteria, and the backout runbook pinned here. https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-v2.8.md

alex: I can own rollout coordination. Owners: alex (deploy), priya (runtime metrics), dan (infra/fallback). @oncall-sre will monitor alerts. Pin criteria: if latency > 2x P50 baseline OR errors > 1% sustained for 5m, we consider auto-backout.

priya: Copy. Backout runbook summary: 1) Pin traffic to previous model/version; 2) Abort canary and scale down new pods; 3) Toggle migration flag if needed; 4) Notify customers & update release notes. Full runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-v2.8.md

priya: Quick commands:
```
# pin previous release
redwoodctl deploy pin --service inference-api --version v2.7.4
# abort canary
redwoodctl rollout abort --canary-id canary-2869804321
# toggle migration off
feature-flags set m2_migration false --env prod
```

dan: Adding thresholds to watch: 1) Token gen latency (p99) > 1200ms or 2x baseline for 3m, 2) 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m, 3) embedding mismatch / hallucination alerts from evals > 0.5%. Also ensure KV cache warming before ramp.

alex: Priya — can you run the pre-warm job ~5m before canary? command is `./scripts/warm_kv.sh --region=us-west --load=100k`

priya: Yep will run pre-warm at 13:55 UTC.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary start triggered by carla at 2026-03-20T14:00:00Z. Canary id canary-2869804321. 5% traffic -> us-west. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.8.0 

carla: Noted — checking DB migration toggle: I will keep it off for canary, enable for full rollout. Runbook snippet says migration is backwards-compatible but we'll be conservative.

dan: Oncall watchlist: @oncall-sre, alex, priya. If we see an alert we escalate to eng-sre channel and runbook owner (priya). Set auto-backout timer 12m after canary start if threshold met.

deploy-bot: Canary update: canary-2869804321 now at 5% in us-west — 60s in. Metrics: p50 110ms, p99 420ms, 5xx 0.04%. :rocket:

carla: Seeing a 20% spike in token-latency p50 on the canary traces (not p99 yet). tagging priya. Should we pin or wait?

priya: Pulling traces. If p50 stays > 1.5x baseline for 6m, we auto-backout. For now I'll watch 4 more minutes. Starting `trace query` and synthetic check.

deploy-bot: Synthetic check failed: embed-eval mismatch > 0.6% in the canary cohort (threshold 0.5%). Marking canary unhealthy based on policy.

carla: Ok that's over threshold. Proceeding to abort and pin. I'll run rollback commands now.

alex: I'll stand by to help pin and confirm traffic shift. Dan, prepping infra rollback (scale down + route reassign).

carla: Running: `redwoodctl rollout abort --canary-id canary-2869804321 && redwoodctl deploy pin --service inference-api --version v2.7.4`

deploy-bot: Rollback executed for canary-2869804321. Traffic reverted to v2.7.4. Backout runbook executed: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-v2.8.md. Incident ticket created: INC-8742.

priya: Verified: new pods scaled to 0, p99/p50 returned to baseline. Kicking off short postmortem doc in docs/release/2.8-postmortem.md — assigning owners.

dan: Noting follow-ups: reproduce locally with the same kv population, rerun quantization checks, and limit DB migration toggle to a follow-up patch.

carla: Great. Closing change window early. Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the postmortem to decide next steps. :white_check_mark:
